title: Odd Semester Commencement
answer: Odd Semester (3rd, 5th, 7th and 9th Semester) classes commence from 14 July 2025.

title: 1st Semester Commencement
answer: First Semester classes commence from 4 August 2025.

title: Enrollment Odd Semester
answer: Enrollment for continuing students is from 1 July to 19 July 2025.

title: Mid Semester Examination
answer: Mid Semester Examination will be held from 1 September to 6 September 2025.

title: Unit Test II
answer: Unit Test II will be conducted from 22 September to 26 September 2025.

title: Theory Examination Odd Semester
answer: Odd Semester Theory Examination will be held from 24 November to 12 December 2025.

title: Practical Examination
answer: Practical, Viva and SkillX examinations will be conducted from 15 December to 23 December 2025.

title: Odd Semester Result
answer: Odd Semester results will be published on 10 January 2026.

title: Even Semester Commencement
answer: Even Semester classes commence from 1 January 2026.

title: Convocation
answer: 6th Convocation will be held on 3 February 2026.

title: Alumni Meet
answer: Alumni Meet is scheduled on 8 February 2026.

title: Cultural Festival
answer: JIS University Cultural Festival will be held on 27 and 28 February 2026.

title: Even Semester Mid Semester
answer: Even Semester Mid Semester Examination will be held from 23 March to 28 March 2026.

title: Farewell
answer: Farewell Program for outgoing students will be held on 23 April 2026.

title: Even Semester Theory Exam
answer: Even Semester Theory Examination will be held from 11 May to 23 May 2026.

title: Even Semester Result
answer: Even Semester results will be published on 15 June 2026.

title: Summer Quarter
answer: Summer Quarter classes commence from 1 June 2026.

title: Student Satisfaction Survey
answer: Student Satisfaction Survey will be conducted from 25 June to 27 June 2026.

title: Academic Audit
answer: Academic and Administrative Audit will be held from 2 July to 7 July 2026.
